يجنون (form I)
# يَجُنُّونَ (yajunnūna) /ja.d͡ʒun.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of جَنَّ (janna)
# يُجَنُّونَ (yujannūna) /ju.d͡ʒan.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
